hero_title: The modern BBQ planner for your HomeLab.
hero_subtitle: Plan events, let guests place orders and work through everything as grill master – burgers, sausages, steaks, sides and drinks in one clean web app.
no_public_events: There is currently no public BBQ event.
login_failed: Login failed. Please check your username and password.
title: Title
no_items_selected: Please choose at least one product with quantity greater than 0.
order_saved: Order saved. The grill master can now see it on the todo list.
ready_hint: As soon as something is ready, it will automatically appear as done here.
empty_kitchen: No orders for this event yet.
upload_hint: The JSON may only contain simple key/value text entries. Missing strings automatically fall back to German/English.
admin_password_hint: Default user: Griller. Set the password through GRILLER_ADMIN_PASSWORD in .env.
public_hint: Set the status to Public so guests can see and join the event.
invalid_language: Language pack could not be saved. Please check JSON and language code.
footer: Made for relaxed BBQ events, clean HomeLab dashboards and hungry guests.
confirm_delete_event: Really delete this event? All guests and orders for this event will be removed.
cannot_delete_category_with_products: Category cannot be deleted while products are still assigned to it. Move or delete the products first.
cannot_delete_product_with_orders: Product cannot be deleted because it has already been used in orders. Please deactivate it instead.
delete_product_hint: Tip: Products that have already been ordered are not hard-deleted for traceability. In that case, simply remove the Active checkmark and save.
guests_hint: The event overview shows how many guests have already joined and ordered.
no_guests: No guests for this event yet.
guest_deleted: Guest deleted. Related orders were removed as well.
confirm_delete_guest: Really delete this guest? All orders from this guest will be removed as well.
guest_delete_hint: This shows every guest who joined the event. Deleting a guest also removes their orders.
qr_url_hint: If the QR code does not work, this URL can also be opened or copied manually.
qr_too_long: The public link is too long for the built-in QR code. The URL below can still be used.
drag_sort_hint: Drag rows by the handle into the desired order, then save the order.
guest_pin_hint: With name + PIN, you can be assigned to the same guest profile again later.
invalid_pin: The PIN must contain exactly 4 digits.
guest_restored: Welcome back. Your guest profile was restored.
setup_hint: Create your administrator account on first use. Minimum 6 characters. Complete setup on a trusted local network.
setup_invalid: Invalid setup token, username, or password (minimum 12 characters).
weather_hint: Optional: set your location to show current weather on the admin dashboard. Data is provided by Open-Meteo.
password_error: Incorrect current password or new password too short.
ingredient_hint: Manage toppings, buns, sauces and extras once, then assign them to multiple products.
name: Name
confirm_delete_ingredient: Delete this ingredient from all products?
select_ingredients_hint: Choose the reusable ingredients offered for this product.
join_hint: Scan, choose, enjoy. Just enter your name to join. A 4-digit PIN is optional for returning guests.
choose_category: What are you in the mood for?
choose_category_hint: Choose a category to start, or browse everything on the next screen.
tap_to_add: Use + / − to pick a quantity, then add your favorite toppings.
review_hint: Make sure everything looks right before submitting.
no_orders_yet: Your first order will appear here.
order_locked: This order is already being prepared and can no longer be changed or cancelled.
delete_product_warning: Deleting a product permanently removes its associated order items. Back up your data first.
guest_profile_hint: Permanently remove a returning guest profile and all related event registrations and orders. Guests without a PIN are managed in each event.
confirm_delete_profile: Permanently delete this profile, its event joins and all orders?
tls_hint: Optional: upload a PEM certificate and its matching private key. HTTPS runs internally on port 443 (e.g. host port 8443). A self-signed certificate is used until a custom one is uploaded.
tls_restart: Restart the Docker container after upload so Apache loads the new certificate.
tls_upload_success: Certificate saved. Please restart the container.
tls_upload_invalid: Invalid certificate, private key, or certificate/key mismatch.
inventory_hint: Optional. Without stock tracking, guests can order as before. When enabled, configured quantities are reserved at checkout. Blank quantities mean unlimited.
inventory_blank: Enter a quantity or leave blank (∞). Zero means sold out.
inventory_product_hint: Optional limits per product, in addition to ingredient recipes.
stock_conflict: Not enough stock for “{name}”. Adjust your order or ask your host.
stock_conflict_general: Insufficient stock for the quantity selected. Adjust quantity or toppings.
recipe_hint: Example burger: 1 patty + 1 bun. Required ingredients are counted automatically; select optional toppings above.
recipe_zero_hint: Zero means the ingredient is not required by the recipe.
forecast_unavailable: No weather forecast available yet for this date.
nav_dashboard_intro: Your BBQ at a glance – everything that matters, in one place.
nav_no_events_hint: Create your first event so guests can order using a QR code.
nav_no_orders: No orders for this event yet.
nav_events_intro: Create, manage and clone your BBQ events in one place.
nav_event_manage_text: Create an event, configure products and stock, then open the grill board.
